meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: NBC News: hides ad containers and NBC News Plus upsells, blurs or hides story pictures, can hide video modules, credits and footer
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chrome, https://www.nbcnews.com/ with an iPhone UA and a desktop UA. Both returned the same Next.js markup, so selectors apply to both. Article pages were not inspected.

- **Ad containers**: `[data-testid="ad__container"]` 19 desktop, 20 phone (LIVE). The slots were empty boxes in the headless visit.
- **Plus upsells**: `#hfs-subscribe-link` 1 and `[data-testid="subscriber-badge"]` 25 (LIVE).
- **Story pictures**: `picture[data-testid="picture"]` 50 desktop, 49 phone (LIVE).
- **Video modules** `[data-testid="storyline-media-video"]` 12, **credits** `[data-testid="image-credit"]` 23, **durations** `[data-testid="card-duration"]` 21, **footer** `footer.hfsf` 1 (LIVE).

Not verified: article and video pages, the live player, the breaking-news bar, newsletter prompts. Classes with `styles_..__Hash` suffixes are CSS-module hashes and are not used; selectors use `data-testid`, the stable `hfs-` ids and the plain `hfsf` footer class. Hide video modules would also hide the lead video on pages where it is the main content.
